annotations.bnjettag.io/status: gate-15 node discriminator (c6017); no training; ~0.2 GPU-h; REGRESSION_TICKET.md §3 item 1
annotations.bnjettag.io/single-arm-justified: diagnostic pod: init + initial EBOPs trace only (4 processes), no training arm
annotations.bnjettag.io/cluster-ops-read: kubectl get pod -l app=kai-delta0926-discrim-c6017 -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.containerStatuses[*].imageID} {.items[*].spec.nodeName}' (imageID is not readable in the pod)

containers.name: train
args:
set -euo pipefail
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
echo "DISCRIM_NODE $NODE_NAME"
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '705a554b8da0395bf015a60743a0ea97304ecb9261c3a43d8619404f5c4c6f98  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
unset BNJ_DATA_ROOT BNJ_RUN_ROOT WANDB_API_KEY
export BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/delta0926
export TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=true NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-training.txt
NVLIBS=$(python -c "import glob; print(':'.join(sorted(glob.glob('/usr/local/lib/python*/site-packages/nvidia/*/lib'))))")
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$NVLIBS${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "300be87bf0cde5fba95c7b9cf0798718475e2b2dd6a230ee44a58a22fa8d467c" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "GATE15_CACHE_NOT_READY /data/chang-n64-20260926"; exit 9; }
OUT=/data/delta-20260927/discriminator/kai-delta0926-discrim-c6017-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ); mkdir -p $OUT
RC=0
rc=0; python -u /work/code/campaigns/delta0926/fingerprint_check.py --env-report --run delta0926-w2-rep-a-t350000-s1 --data-root /data/chang-n64-20260926 2>&1 | tee $OUT/s1-r1.log || rc=$?; echo "DISCRIM_RESULT s1-r1 exit $rc"; test "$rc" = 0 || RC=9
rc=0; python -u /work/code/campaigns/delta0926/fingerprint_check.py --run delta0926-w2-rep-a-t350000-s2 --data-root /data/chang-n64-20260926 2>&1 | tee $OUT/s2-r1.log || rc=$?; echo "DISCRIM_RESULT s2-r1 exit $rc"; test "$rc" = 0 || RC=9
rc=0; python -u /work/code/campaigns/delta0926/fingerprint_check.py --run delta0926-w2-rep-a-t350000-s1 --data-root /data/chang-n64-20260926 2>&1 | tee $OUT/s1-r2.log || rc=$?; echo "DISCRIM_RESULT s1-r2 exit $rc"; test "$rc" = 0 || RC=9
rc=0; python -u /work/code/campaigns/delta0926/fingerprint_check.py --run delta0926-w2-rep-a-t350000-s2 --data-root /data/chang-n64-20260926 2>&1 | tee $OUT/s2-r2.log || rc=$?; echo "DISCRIM_RESULT s2-r2 exit $rc"; test "$rc" = 0 || RC=9
grep -h "^FINGERPRINT " $OUT/*.log || true
test "$RC" = 0 && echo DISCRIM_ALL_MATCH || echo DISCRIM_MISMATCH
exit $RC
